entries.title: Every key in the mod
q: what keys does the mod use
entries.answer: U your life in town · K camera · J village journal · V emote wheel (hold) · H this Guide · [ ] \ time slower, faster, normal (operators) · B plot book, R orders, G roster, ; crew (assistants). Unbound until you set them: favourite folk, your finances, the admin panel (operators).
tips: Every key is in Options → Controls → Key Binds under the mod's own category; change any there.

entries.title: Changing a key
q: how do i change a keybind
entries.answer: Open Options → Controls → Key Binds and scroll to the mod's category (MC Assistant). Click a key and press the new one. Some keys start unbound (favourite folk, your finances, the admin panel): set them there.
tips: A key shown in red clashes with another; give one of them a different key.

entries.title: The inventory's buttons (coin and Guide)
q: what is the coin button in my inventory
buttons next to the recipe book
entries.answer: Your inventory (E) has two of the mod's buttons beside the recipe book: the coin opens Your finances, and the book opens this Guide. In the creative inventory they sit beside the panel's lower right corner.
tips: The coin button can be hidden in the client config (mc_assistant-ui-client.toml).

entries.title: Keys inside the screens
q: keyboard shortcuts in the talk screen
how do i close a screen
entries.answer: Talk screen: 1-9 pick an option, T or Enter to type, Esc or Backspace back up, Esc to say goodbye. Town's books: 1-7 sections, Tab the next, left/right the pages. Counters: up/down, Enter, + and −, Tab through kinds, B to buy. Camera: Esc, Space, arrows, wheel, H. Guide: Enter, up/down history, Esc back.

entries.title: Hiding labels (F1)
q: how do i hide the icons over villagers
entries.answer: F1 hides every label of the mod's: name tags, the little pictures over heads, speech bubbles, trade icons, quest marks and the founding and building outlines. Name-tag detail and range are set in the camera screen.

entries.title: Fast time ([ ] \ keys)
q: how do i speed up time
what do the bracket keys do
entries.answer: ] steps time faster (2×, 4×, 8× … 256×, then max), [ a step slower, \ back to normal; the village journal (J) has the same as buttons. The top right corner shows the speed asked for and what the server really manages. Operators, or the owner of a single-player world, may change it.
warn: It speeds up everything, you included: watch from somewhere safe, or in creative or spectator.
